no_adcom_quote.quote: No issues were identified that would warrant an advisory committee meeting. The efficacy and safety findings were clear and consistent with expectation with an IL-6R biologic antagonist. Thus, an advisory committee was not held for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the KEVZARA (sarilumab) BLA. Both the Summary Review and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review state that no issues were identified that would warrant an advisory committee, with the efficacy and safety findings judged clear and consistent with expectations for an IL-6R antagonist. With no AdComm held, there were no committee-driven changes to the approval.
